HE_relevant_paragraphs: 本研究分析寰枢关节紊乱模型雄性大鼠含RVLM及邻近组织的腹外侧延髓取材块中的氧化应激指标和Nox1/Nox4 mRNA，并与取出异物后在较晚终点取样的复位组比较。来源实验的血压数据与相关报道[22]共享；本报告的生化和转录本分析未在该报道中呈现。存档血压记录和HE图像另作描述性背景资料呈现。这些比较用于表征分子关联，未检验NOX信号是否介导血压升高。
HE图像的制备与说明性呈现
数据以均值 ± 标准差（SD）表示，以独立大鼠为实验单位。各终点样本量与起始分配数量分别报告。对延髓SOD、MDA及探针相关荧光的分析纳入每组全部6个提供的处理值，未剔除离群值，也未填补缺失值。同一动物的重复观察不计为新增生物学重复。 HE图像及存档血压记录仅作描述性呈现，未进行组间显著性检验；血压来源行和录入汇总不计作新的独立生物学重复。
保留的HE图像中可见紫蓝色核染色、粉红色背景组织及不同形态的细胞轮廓（S1图）。这些图像展示来源资料所标注的伪手术、模型及复位视野。由于制片动物数、个体对应及视野采样记录无法确认，图像不作为组间形态差异、神经元损伤或复位后组织恢复的证据。
HE图像仅提供所展示视野的组织学外观。图像保留了来源分组标签，但各组动物数、图像对应个体、切片及视野采样方案无法确认，原标尺校准记录也未获得核查。因此不能认为这些视野代表各组普遍形态，不能估计神经元数量或密度，也不能证明组织学恢复。常规HE染色缺少细胞特异性标记，不能据此识别活化的小胶质细胞、星形胶质细胞或浸润免疫细胞，更不能确立NOX依赖的细胞机制。

HE_relevant_paragraphs: We analyzed oxidative stress markers and Nox1/Nox4 mRNA in ventrolateral medullary tissue blocks containing the RVLM and adjacent tissue from male rats with atlantoaxial joint disorder and compared them with a restoration group sampled at a later endpoint after implant removal. Blood pressure observations from the source experiment were shared with our related report [22]. The biochemical and transcript analyses presented here were not reported in that publication. Archived blood-pressure records and H&E images were additionally presented as descriptive context. These comparisons describe molecular associations and do not test whether NOX signaling mediates elevated blood pressure.
Preparation and illustrative presentation of H&E images

The reported preparation of histological material comprised transcardial perfusion with 4% paraformaldehyde in 0.1 mol/L PBS (pH 7.4), postfixation at 4°C for 24–48 h, paraffin embedding, and sectioning at 4 μm. The supplied H&E procedure described xylene dewaxing, graded ethanol rehydration, hematoxylin staining, acid-alcohol differentiation, lithium-carbonate blueing, eosin staining, dehydration, clearing, and mounting. The retained composite was displayed with its source group labels, preserving tissue and original scale-bar pixels. The number of rats contributing specimens per group, image-to-animal correspondence, and section- and field-selection records could not be confirmed. The images were illustrative; no cell counting, density measurement, histological scoring, or between-group statistical comparison was performed on them.

Data are presented as mean ± standard deviation (SD), with individual rats as the experimental units. Endpoint sample sizes were reported separately from initial allocation numbers. All 6 supplied processed values per group were included in the analyses of medullary SOD, MDA, and probe-associated fluorescence; no outliers were removed and no missing values were imputed. Repeated observations from the same animal did not constitute additional biological replicates. H&E images and archived blood-pressure entries were displayed descriptively, without between-group significance tests; worksheet rows and entered summaries did not constitute new independent biological replicates.

The retained H&E images showed purple-blue nuclear staining, pink background tissue, and cellular profiles of varied shapes (S1 Fig). They illustrate fields labelled sham-operated, model, and restoration in the source material. Because specimen counts, animal correspondence, and field-sampling records could not be confirmed, these images were not treated as evidence of between-group morphological differences, neuronal injury, or histological recovery after implant removal.

The H&E images provide only a histological view of the displayed fields. Source group labels were retained, but the number of rats contributing specimens per group, image-to-animal correspondence, and section- and field-sampling schemes could not be confirmed; scale-calibration records were also unavailable for inspection. The fields therefore cannot establish the prevailing morphology of each group, quantify neuronal number or density, or demonstrate histological recovery. Routine H&E staining lacks cell-specific markers and cannot establish activation of microglia or astrocytes, identify infiltrating immune cells, or establish a NOX-dependent cellular mechanism.

S1 Fig. H&E images labelled sham-operated, model, and restoration in the supplied material. The three fields retain the source order and tissue pixels; the scale bars are labelled 100 μm in the source image, and calibration records were unavailable for independent inspection. These images illustrate only the appearance of the displayed fields. The number of rats contributing specimens per group, image-to-animal correspondence, and field-selection records could not be confirmed. No quantitative or between-group statistical analysis was performed. The fields do not establish within-group consistency, changes in neuronal number, or histological recovery after implant removal. Group labels outside the images are in English; the supplied composite is retained in S6 File.
S6 File. Supplied H&E composite with the original Chinese group labels and scale bars. This assembled material is not an individual-animal microscope export or a complete image archive.

optional_editorial_advisory.issue: The general wording that routine H&E cannot identify infiltrating immune cells could be narrower. The intended conclusion for the present fields is correct, but H&E can in some settings show inflammatory infiltrates.
